text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis against self-driving cars","quality":"positioning","description":"It states a definite stance early and keeps the essay aimed at that argument."},{"evidence":"three body paragraphs with To begin / To continue / Next","quality":"organization","description":"It uses a clearer paragraph structure and transitions to separate its reasons."},{"evidence":"sensor list and $200 million radar cost","quality":"use of evidence","description":"It supports claims with specific details from the article rather than mostly restating them."},{"evidence":"homeless, education, therapy lessons","quality":"reasoning development","description":"It extends ideas beyond the source by explaining why the money and effort might be better spent elsewhere."},{"evidence":"self driving perfect cars shut down, and caused someone to loose their life","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"It anticipates safety objections and tries to answer them by emphasizing failure risks."},{"evidence":"intro body and conclusion with a closing question","quality":"essay completeness","description":"It more fully meets the prompt’s argumentative-essay form with an introduction, developed body, and conclusion."}]}
